method: Each model answers the same frozen items (benchmarks/data/answers/items.jsonl: English, Hindi and Hinglish; answerable, comparison-table and unanswerable questions) from the same 3-6 passages, through the engine's own grounded-answer path (C2 Customer support template, prompt compiler, fact gate, LiteLLM streaming). Scores are deterministic checks over the saved answers; fluency is an optional LLM judge.
